title: 第25章 秘密泄露第26章 杨灵虎突破
content_zh:
“确实如此。”
高辉点头道:“杨家此前出了个资质不错的孩子，一年时间便有了聚气二重境界，那位杨家主也是修为再进，突破了聚气六重，家中尚有一个忠臣老奴，也是聚气六重。”
“哦？”
何胜来闻言眼睛一转:“那确实还有几分实力，这家主也是个有手段的，能招来一位聚气六重的修士辅佐。不过...”
他忽然话锋一转，眼神变得锐利起来。
“哼，一年之内，培养出一个聚气二重修士，又突破了一个聚气六重，他小小杨家能有这能耐？”
高辉沉吟片刻道:“何大人的意思是...”
“我猜，这杨家肯定有秘密，今日正好来了，就好好瞧上一瞧！”
高辉正欲开口，杨贯峰已出门迎接。
“王朝高修大驾光临，未曾远迎，还望恕罪。”
杨贯峰拱手施礼道。
何胜来扫过他一眼，淡淡道：“奉命行事而已，迎不迎的无所谓，带路吧。”
“是。”
转身间，杨贯峰与高辉悄悄交换了一个眼神，从他眼中看出了些许无奈，便也明白了这名王朝修士是何等做派。
从刚才那句话就能听出，他丝毫没有将杨家放在眼里，命令式的口吻让人听着总是不舒服。
带领二人来到杨家后院，余老和杨灵睿已经在这里等候。
那些妖兽尸体也在经过余老的处理后，转移到了这里。
主要是抹除了灵力冲击的痕迹，因为那种伤势太过特别，很容易让人看出端倪。
不过好在这何胜来本身境界也不高，清点过一遍后也没有发觉异常。
总共二十八具妖兽尸体，其中聚气初期妖兽尸体十八具，聚气中期妖兽尸体十具，何胜来报出收购价格，总共一百三十块灵晶。

“呵呵呵，你们杨家也是走运，白石镇都破了，你们也没碰上个聚气后期的妖兽，不然全都得死绝。”何胜来自顾自的说道。
高辉站在他身后没忍住翻了个白眼。
这还站在人家家里呢，何胜来说话实在不中听。
杨贯峰倒是一直陪着笑脸道：“何大人说的是，能度过此次兽潮危机，我杨家实属侥幸。”
一百三十灵晶对现在的杨家来说无疑是一笔巨款，而且来得相当及时。
有了这笔钱，那禁地的防御阵法，还有杨家修士的储物袋就算有着落了。
至于这何胜来，杨贯峰和余老在外闯荡什么样的人没见过，不可能因为三言两语就与人动怒，爱怎么说就随他去吧。
本以为收购完毕，事情就结束，但何胜来却好像并没有要走的意思。
他抬眼看向杨家北侧的山崖，虚眯起眼睛。
“好一处断壁绝崖，恐怕上头是另有玄机吧。”何胜来道。
杨贯峰向前一步：“回何大人，上方乃是我杨家禁地。”
“哦~禁地啊...”
何胜来点点头，随后十分随意的说道：“带我去看看。”
“这！”
听到这话，杨贯峰和余老都是脸色一变，年纪尚浅的杨灵睿更是露出慌张的神采。
高辉也是眉头紧皱，沉声道：“何大人，杨家从去年就已经搬离了镇子，脱离王朝管辖，此事恐怕不妥。”
content_en:
"Indeed."
Gao Hui nodded and said: "The Yang family gave birth to a child with good qualifications before. He reached the second level of Qi gathering in one year. The head of the Yang family also improved further and broke through the sixth level of Qi gathering. There is still a loyal old slave in the family who is also at the sixth level of Qi gathering."
"Oh?"
He Shenglai rolled his eyes when he heard this: "That does still have some strength. The head of the family is also capable and can recruit a monk at the sixth level of Qi Gathering to assist. But..."
He suddenly changed the subject and his eyes became sharp.
"Hmph, within one year, he trained a second-level Qi-gathering monk and broke through to a sixth-level Qi-gathering monk. Can his little Yang family have such ability?"
Gao Hui pondered for a moment and said: "Master He means..."
"I guess the Yang family must have a secret. I just happened to be here today, so I'll take a good look!"
Just as Gao Hui was about to speak, Yang Guanfeng had already gone out to greet him.
"The high-ranking cultivators from the dynasty are here. I didn't come far to welcome you. I hope you will forgive me."
Yang Guanfeng cupped his hands and saluted.
He Shenglai glanced at him and said calmly: "I'm just following orders. It doesn't matter whether we welcome you or not. Just lead the way."
"Yes."
As they turned around, Yang Guanfeng and Gao Hui quietly exchanged a look. He could see a little helplessness in his eyes, and he understood what kind of style this dynasty monk had.
It can be heard from what he said just now that he does not take the Yang family seriously at all, and his commanding tone always makes people feel uncomfortable.
He led the two of them to the Yang family's backyard, where Mr. Yu and Yang Lingrui were already waiting.
The monster corpses were also moved here after being processed by Mr. Yu.
The main purpose is to erase the traces of the spiritual impact, because the injury is so special that it is easy for people to see the clues.
Fortunately, He Shenglai himself was not at a high level, and after taking an inventory, he found no abnormalities.
There were a total of twenty-eight monster corpses, including eighteen corpses of monster beasts in the early stage of Qi gathering and ten corpses of monsters in the middle stage of Qi gathering. He Shenglai quoted the purchase price, a total of one hundred and thirty spiritual crystals.
"Hehehe, you Yang family are also lucky. Baishi Town has been destroyed, and you haven't encountered a monster in the late stage of Qi gathering, otherwise you will all be dead." He Sheng said self-consciously.
Gao Hui stood behind him and couldn't help but rolled his eyes.
Still standing in someone else's house, what He Shenglai said was really not pleasant to listen to.
Yang Guanfeng kept smiling and said: "Master He is saying that it is a blessing for our Yang family to survive this beast crisis."
One hundred and thirty spiritual crystals is undoubtedly a huge sum of money for the current Yang family, and it comes quite timely.
With this money, the defensive formations of the forbidden area and the storage bags of the Yang family monks are now available.
As for He Shenglai, Yang Guanfeng and Mr. Yu have never seen what kind of people they are wandering around outside. It is impossible to get angry with others just because of a few words. Just let him say whatever he likes.
I thought that the matter would be over after the acquisition was completed, but He Shenglai seemed to have no intention of leaving.
He raised his eyes to look at the cliff on the north side of Yang's house and narrowed his eyes.
"What a cliff. I'm afraid there's another mystery behind it." He Shenglai said.
Yang Guanfeng took a step forward: "Master He, the top is the forbidden area of my Yang family."
"Oh~ the forbidden area..."
He Shenglai nodded, and then said very casually: "Take me to have a look."
"This!"
Hearing this, Yang Guanfeng and Mr. Yu's expressions changed, and Yang Lingrui, who was still young, even looked panicked.
Gao Hui also frowned and said in a deep voice: "Master He, the Yang family has moved out of the town last year and separated from the jurisdiction of the dynasty. This may not be appropriate."
